name: Shenzhen Hans Motor S&T Co.,Ltd
name_zh: 深圳市大族电机科技有限公司
summary: Han's Motor is a wholly owned subsidiary of Han's Laser that develops, manufactures and sells direct-drive motion components and servo systems. Its portfolio includes linear motors, torque motors, frameless motors, voice-coil motors, robotic joint modules and precision positioning platforms for semiconductor equipment, machine tools and industrial automation.
